Great question! 🌿 If you upgraded on the 26th, that's **after the 25th**, so the change would apply to the **following month's box** instead of the next one.

- **On the 25th:** Your next box would already be billed on your current Starter plan.
- **Following month:** The Collector plan would kick in, billed on the 25th and shipped in the first full week of the month after.

So upgrading today (the 22nd) gets you a Collector box a month sooner. 🪴

I also need to fix my last message. I was wrong to retract the guarantee length. Plant Club plants do have the normal Plant Care Guarantee of **30 days from delivery** (**90 days** for Leafy Plus members, on plants ordered while the membership is active). Sorry for the confusion!

Is there anything else I can help with? Happy upgrading! 🌱
